goal: Separate the node, wallet, and GUI into distinct executables to isolate processes
Prevent GUI hangs when long operations hold core locks and isolate wallet key management
reviewability: Code and CI are clean and passing
agreement: Broad concept support across maintainers for process separation between node, wallet, and GUI
Strong support for process isolation and auto-generated IPC (laanwj, Sjors, jimhashhq)
Early objection to Cap'n Proto dependency resolved as acceptable for internal use (gmaxwell)
Early preference for existing RPC resolved by need for bidirectional async calls (dcousens)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it implements the milestone process-separation architecture for Bitcoin Core
Enables running node, wallet, and GUI separately and unblocks follow-up connection PRs

categories.name: rpc
why: P4 because changes are limited to passing a logging suffix and adding a comment note
Does not modify any RPC commands, schemas, or server mechanisms

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it fixes callback destruction timing in signals to destroy slots eagerly on disconnect
Prevents unpredictable resource lifetime issues across general node signal callbacks
